deadline_text_verbatim: Harvard welcomes interested applicants to apply under our Restrictive Early Action plan by November 1 in order to be notified of a decision in mid-December. Your portions of the application are due by November 1 at 11:59pm (your local time).
researcher_notes: Page states month/day only, no year, and is evergreen (no cycle-year qualifier found anywhere on this page or the general first-year-applicants/application-requirements pages after three separate checks). As of retrieval (2026-08-21) the next unclosed occurrence of this recurring date would be 1 November 2026 (for Fall 2027 entry / Class of 2031) — this is this researcher's inference from the retrieval date and the recurring pattern, NOT a page-stated year, and deadline_date is deliberately left null rather than synthesizing that inference into a stored date. Decision notification: 'mid-December' (also undated). Testing note: for REA, test results are requested by end of October, with the November test series acceptable if needed (see requirement HAR0006 for the self-report/official-score mechanics).

deadline_text_verbatim: QuestBridge applications are due at the end of September.
researcher_notes: Harvard's own restatement of a platform-wide QuestBridge deadline. Cross-referenced to DL-2026-08-21-HAR0006, sourced directly from questbridge.org (the program operator), which states the National College Match application deadline as 'October 1' at '11:59 p.m. Pacific Time' — a materially different date than Harvard's 'end of September.' Per this lane's precedent (coordination DECISION 1: an official application system is the primary authority for facts it owns, e.g. the UCAS/Glasgow equal-consideration-date conflict resolved in favour of UCAS), questbridge.org should outrank this restatement for the deadline's exact date — but both are recorded, neither silently dropped, per standing lane discipline.

source_authority_note: questbridge.org does not match the .edu/.ac./.gov suffix gate in lib/acquisition/source-authority.ts (it is a plain .org domain). Per source-authority-gap.md piece B, QuestBridge is a closed, hand-curatable application-system operator (same shape as UCAS/Common App/Studielink) and should be HIGH authority for the platform-wide deadlines it owns once an APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier exists. Must not be ingested today by relaxing the domain gate.
researcher_notes: Operator's own page. Cross-referenced to DL-2026-08-21-HAR0005 (Harvard's restatement, which says 'end of September' instead of October 1 — see that record). This researcher's fetch of this page did not surface an explicit year printed alongside 'October 1'; a search-result snippet (not itself used as the record source) suggested '2026' for the upcoming cycle, but that was not independently confirmed by direct fetch, so cycle_year is left null and deadline_date is left null rather than promoted on unverified evidence — consistent with 'search discovers, fetch verifies.'
